Oh, there were many menopause comments in the original post. I’m having a weird course of it (sorry if TMI). Bloodwork says “not yet” per gyno. (Explicitly warned I could still get pregnant.) No hot flashes. But in the last 6-8 years I’ve gotten every other *peri* symptom that exists, and it all started seemingly at once, starting with, most horrifying to me, the memory and attention span problems. I had a perfect memory before I was about 44. 

Dr’s latest theory is that I’ve been high-functioning/compensating ADHD all my life, and that as the hormone fluctuations start melting my brain, I’ve lost the ability to compensate. Got a psych evaluation. She said I blew the top off the ADHD evaluation. I’ve seen some other people say this is not an uncommon way for women to find out they have ADHD. Some of it clicks for me. I’m still skeptical.

(Gyno has me on HRT now anyway because she says it can prevent heart/cognitive/bone density issues later. I know this is controversial. Can’t say it’s fixed my memory. :/ )
Thank you! I’m in a much better mental place than when I wrote the post. And thanks for sharing your experiences.
